# CANDIDATE: FIX_LAZY_IMPORT_FLEET_MARKET

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** quality_gate  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The fleet_market.py module uses lazy imports (importing inside functions) for lib.filters and lib.watchers, which can cause ImportError or silent failures in the prod-faithful environment (where backtest/ is on sys.path) leading to permanently-dead producer lanes in the fleet arms. Changing to package-relative imports ensures the module is importable and avoids silent failures.

## Mechanism

Replace lazy imports inside functions in automation/state/fleet/fleet_market.py with top-level package-relative imports. Specifically, change:
   from lib.filters import ...
   from lib.watchers import ...
to import at the top of the module using `from lib.filters import ...` and `from lib.watchers import ...` (assuming lib is accessible via sys.path which includes backtest/).
